pairs: Et die tertia nuptiæ factæ sunt in Cana Galilææ,
And on the third day, a wedding was held in Cana of Galilee,
and the mother of Jesus was there.
Vocatus est autem et Jesus, et discipuli ejus,
Now Jesus was also invited to the wedding,
And when the wine was failing,
the mother of Jesus said to him,
“What is that to me and to you,
My hour has not yet arrived.”
His mother said to the servants,
Erant autem ibi lapideæ hydriæ sex positæ secundum purificationem Judæorum,
Now in that place, there were six stone water jars, for the purification ritual of the Jews,
capientes singulæ metretas binas vel ternas.
containing two or three measures each.
Et impleverunt eas usque ad summum.
And they filled them to the very top.
and carry it to the chief steward of the feast.”
And they took it to him.
Ut autem gustavit architriclinus aquam vinum factam,
when the chief steward had tasted the water made into wine,
since he did not know where it was from,
for only the servants who had drawn the water knew,
the chief steward called the groom,
Omnis homo primum bonum vinum ponit
“Every man offers the good wine first,
Tu autem servasti bonum vinum usque adhuc.
But you have kept the good wine until now.”
Hoc fecit initium signorum Jesus in Cana Galilææ;
This was the beginning of the signs that Jesus accomplished in Cana of Galilee,
et crediderunt in eum discipuli ejus.
and his disciples believed in him.
After this, he descended to Capernaum,
et mater ejus, et fratres ejus, et discipuli ejus:
with his mother and his brothers and his disciples,
et ibi manserunt non multis diebus.
but they did not remain there for many days.
And the Passover of the Jews was near,
and so Jesus ascended to Jerusalem.
et invenit in templo vendentes boves,
sellers of oxen and sheep and doves,
Et cum fecisset quasi flagellum de funiculis,
And when he had made something like a whip out of little cords,
he drove them all out of the temple,
And he poured out the brass coins of the moneychangers,
And to those who were selling doves,
et nolite facere domum patris mei, domum negotiationis.
and do not make my Father’s house into a house of commerce.”
Recordati sunt vero discipuli ejus quia scriptum est:
And truly, his disciples were reminded that it is written:
“What sign can you show to us,
that you may do these things?”
et in tribus diebus excitabo illud.
and in three days I will raise it up.”
Quadraginta et sex annis ædificatum est templum hoc,
“This temple has been built up over forty-six years,
et tu in tribus diebus excitabis illud?
and you will raise it up in three days?”
Ille autem dicebat de templo corporis sui.
Yet he was speaking about the Temple of his body.
when he had resurrected from the dead,
his disciples were reminded that he had said this,
et crediderunt scripturæ et sermoni quem dixit Jesus.
and they believed in the Scriptures and in the word that Jesus had spoken.
Cum autem esset Jerosolymis in Pascha in die festo,
Now while he was at Jerusalem during the Passover,
on the day of the feast,
seeing his signs that he was accomplishing.
Ipse autem Jesus non credebat semetipsum eis,
But Jesus did not trust himself to them,
because he himself had knowledge of all persons,
et quia opus ei non erat ut quis testimonium perhiberet de homine:
and because he had no need of anyone to offer testimony about a man.
ipse enim sciebat quid esset in homine.
For he knew what was within a man.
